findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 759faf1450afff5a716a9d655d04516955031bba056075526ff5a94951c7018b; all 5 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

Two RRC data dictionaries independently supply the 01-through-14 conversion and mark 8B reserved for future use.
The T-1 guide supplies the limited 6E/06 reporting exception, while the W-10/G-10 specification supports two-character text storage and omits reserved 8B from its accepted list.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Oil and Gas Field Information data dictionary (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC Oil and Gas Field Information data dictionary supplies a field-table-value to district-value conversion for 01 through 14 and marks 8B reserved for future use.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article treats the mapping as source-specific and does not apply it to another file, screen, form, query, or regulatory workflow without its own dictionary.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Tight Sands Gas Leases data dictionary (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official Tight Sands Gas Leases data dictionary independently supplies the same district-column conversion and reserved 8B status.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses this source as corroboration for that dataset context, not as a universal district-code replacement rule.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC T-1 EDI User Guide (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official T-1 EDI User Guide distinguishes normal alphanumeric district designations from a special numeric district field.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article confines the guide statement that East Texas oil field production in district 06 may use 06 or 6E to the T-1 reporting context.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC W-10/G-10 EDI specifications (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official W-10/G-10 EDI specification defines District Code as Varchar (2) and lists accepted alphanumeric values.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The accepted list omits reserved 8B, so the article does not describe 8B as a currently accepted filing value.

sources_inspected.label: Texas RRC Oil and Gas Counties and Districts (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official RRC page visibly uses alphanumeric public district labels including 7B, 7C, and 8A.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to confirm current label form and does not infer county, field, asset, ownership, production, or value relationships.
